title: onChain Shopify
tagline: Onchain Shopify platform; allows users to create online stores on the blockchain.
description: We've developed a user-friendly Shopify-like platform that brings e-commerce to the blockchain seamlessly, allowing users to create fully on-chain stores without any of the typical complexities and friction. These stores offer the ability to buy and sell goods or services using a connected CMS & Database, Built-in Storefront, Frictionless Oauth and wallet creation, and a support ChatBot, all with the added benefit of anonymity and history.
how_its_made:
Our platform ensures a seamless experience with Dynamic for wallet and user onboarding, making it easy for anyone to jump in, regardless of their crypto experience.

We chose Flow blockchain for its proven scalability, ensuring the platform can handle massive growth as the commerce ecosystem expands.

For file hosting, we use Walrus, a reliable solution that ensures secure and efficient storage, maintaining the integrity and accessibility of all on-chain store data.

Google Gemini for the chatbot, as a powerful API with a large context and makes it easy to create chatbots, that connect,  communicate, and work with XMPT as the end user once it is time to actually message and interact with a human using the MessageKit.
